program.title: BEng in Civil and Environmental Engineering
uncertain: total_required_credits is a calculated value: the PDF does not state a fixed total for the major; it is the sum of the required_credits of all groups (using the lower bound for credit ranges such as 3-5, 4-6, 1-4).

Several blocks allow alternative course choices (e.g. CIVL/COMP block, MATH block, PHYS block, CIVL 3210/3610, CIVL 4910/4920, CIVL 4900/UROP 1100), so the actual credits taken by a student may differ from the calculated total.

The Research Option requires a CGA of 3.15 or above to enroll and is optional ('Students may opt to graduate with or without an option'); its 4 credits are included in the calculated total, but a student graduating without an option would not take them.
The Research Option Advanced Electives group (3 credits) does not have a specific course list in the PDF, so its courses array is empty.
Remarks in the PDF note that CIVL 4520 and COMP 1022P were last offered in earlier years and subsequently deleted; they are kept in the lists as printed in the PDF.

The PDF header/footer shows '2026-27 CIEV (4Y) (2025-26 intake)', i.e. the document is the 2025-26 intake curriculum rendered on a 2026-27 template; the year is recorded as 2025-26 per the intake year.
